verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right (phone, one-line headline, CTA), but the CTA sits almost touching the end of 'alive'. The logo is centred over a left-aligned text block, which looks arbitrary, and the badges are tiny. B leaves 'alive' and 'rest.' stranded on their own lines, shrinks the logo into the far-left edge, and blows the badges up to nearly CTA size so they compete with the button. Its phone also splits the copy from the CTA, which scatters the grouping.
